title: [NEXT-735] Using headers.append twice with the Set-Cookie header only adds a single header

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body: ### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information Operating System: Platform: darwin Arch: arm64 Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.4.0: Fri Feb 10 08:08:36 PST 2023; root:xnu-8796.100.721.505.3~4/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000 Binaries: Node: 19.6.0 npm: 9.4.0 Yarn: 3.3.1 pnpm: N/A Relevant packages: next: 13.2.2-canary.3 eslint-config-next: N/A react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 ### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure) Middleware / Edge (API routes, runtime) ### Link to the code that reproduces this issue https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/mystifying-babbage-ruhtyx?file=%2Fpages%2Fapi%2Ftest.ts ### To Reproduce Visit `/api/test` with devtools open to observe the cookies sent with the request. ### Describe the Bug Only a single Set-Cookie header is sent and only a single cookie is set: ### Expected Behavior Two Set-Cookie headers should be added, as the [fetch standard](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-sort-and-combine) specifies. This issue is very similar to #38302; @balazsorban44 [asked](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/38302#issuecomment-1445312910) that I open this issue to track this separate reproduction! ### Which browser are you using? (if relevant) _No response_ ### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant) _No response_ [NEXT-735](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-735/using-headersappend-twice-with-the-set-cookie-header-only-adds-a)
